title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

::: {#aa58c673 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```
:::


Are longer films rated more highly? @fig-runtime-rating plots each film's runtime against its IMDb rating.

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
ax.set_xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
ax.set_ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display}

:::


Mean IMDb rating by decade:

::: {#869a748a .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
